resources.string: Auto-detect suits most meetings. Choose a language only when detection gets it wrong, for example when a meeting opens in a different language from the rest: a wrong choice turns the whole transcript into nonsense. Used by multilingual Whisper models, and by Nemotron 3.5 for every language here except Indonesian and Malay, which it has no setting for. Parakeet v3 takes no language hint and always detects the language itself, and English-only models always transcribe English. One import or one meeting can use a different language.

AI summaries, answers, enhanced notes and titles are written in this language. Same as meeting uses the language the meeting was transcribed in, once that is known; a transcript translated to English is summarised in English. Small on-device models sometimes slip back into English.
%1$s transcribes the saved audio again. The new transcript is shown beside the current one, and nothing is replaced until you choose to use it.\n\nOn this phone that is %2$s for this meeting.

Choosing the language needs a multilingual Whisper model or Nemotron 3.5: Parakeet and English-only models cannot be told which language to expect. Download one in Settings, Transcription.
%1$s needs a multilingual Whisper model: Nemotron 3.5 has no setting for it, and Parakeet and English-only models cannot be told which language to expect. Download one in Settings, Transcription.

Detecting the language again needs a multilingual Whisper model: Parakeet, Nemotron and English-only models do not report the language they hear, so the meeting would keep the language it has now. Download one in Settings, Transcription.
